policy: Route feedback-loop contracts close the AI-native strategy loop from decision event to postgame attribution, habit coaching, and calibration queues without polluting official hard data.

feedback_flow.policy: Persist recommendation evidence, route contract refs, confidence fields, chosen action, rejected options, and result_observed_later placeholder.
Attach observed outcome later; do not rewrite the original advice evidence.
Map outcome deltas to review lanes; separate bad live-state capture from bad hard-data semantics.
Update coaching memory only; never override patch truth, formulas, or generated hard data.
Only queue calibration when repeated outcomes point to semantic/strategy-weight uncertainty; accepted calibration requires rebuild.

entries.no_truth_pollution_policy: Feedback may tune coaching memory, review attribution, and calibration priority; it must not mutate official patch data or hard formula truth without a verified rebuild.
